_evidence: Car-chain inputs of 0x0042dc79 and its callee 0x0040dc8a (compose after cars_0066fef0; ebx and esi are car records rec[0x66fef0,0x41c,0..21], edi the list length 0..7). Word +0x23e (0x67012e + k*0x41c) is the link to the next car as a byte offset from 0x66fef0 (movzx; 0 ends the walk; 'sub eax,0x66fef0; mov [esi+0x23e],ax' stores the same encoding), so it draws 0 or k*0x41c and every followed link lands on a varied car record; a link equal to esi or a cycle ends the walk, and the inc ecx / cmp ecx,8 counter bounds it at 8 hops. [0x604280] is a car pointer (initial je exit for ebx, and the double hop at 0x42dd0c for a chain car) - drawn from the car addresses so both happen (it overrides the alias of cars_0066fef0, under which the double hop could never occur). The 8 dwords at 0x604294 (list scanned for i < edi, written at edi <= 7) are car addresses or 0, so 'already listed' exits occur. Bytes +0x9c (bit 1) and +0x21d (bit 2), words +0xe2 and +0x148/+0x14a/+0x14c/+0x14e (callee: sar 8 / shl 6 / sub) are full-range; [0x603b28] (signed word vs the difference, jge) any i16; [0x603b84] (running maximum of ecx, jge) -2..10 so both outcomes occur. Compares, word arithmetic and stores only: nothing faults.
